map.本工具仅做价税分离与金额分摊计算，不生成发票模板，不提供发票代码/二维码。: This tool only does price-tax separation and amount allocation; it does not generate invoice templates or provide invoice codes/QR codes.
map.不含税金额 = 价税合计 / (1 + 税率)；税额 = 不含税金额 × 税率: Tax-exclusive amount = tax-inclusive total / (1 + rate); tax = tax-exclusive amount × rate
map.基于价税分离公式：由价税合计与税率求不含税金额与税额，支持多张发票拆分与凑整，用: Based on the price-tax separation formula: from the tax-inclusive total and rate, find the tax-exclusive amount and tax; supports splitting across multiple invoices and rounding, for invoice amount allocation and tax computation.
